refresh_policy: GitHub Actions target cadence 5 minutes. GitHub scheduled runs can be delayed; UI marks ETF/FX quotes stale when their market timestamp exceeds 15 minutes.
dynamic_source_note: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint is an unofficial market-data source and may be delayed or unavailable. Daily change uses the previous completed daily close; YTD uses the previous calendar year's final close. VIX is separately labeled because the public Yahoo/Cboe value can itself be delayed around 15 minutes.

VOO.definition_note: P/E Ratio (TTM), Yield, Expense Ratio (net) as published by Yahoo Finance; issuer methodology may differ.
